sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently topping the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The league leaders arrive in excellent form with five consecutive wins and a draw in their last six outings. Alsager Town sit bottom with just 4 points and have won only once in ten games, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to extend their impressive run.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tricky away test at Dawley Town, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth entertain Eccleshall at home. Wolverhampton Casuals, who sit fourth, travel to Wednesfield Community in a fixture between mid-table sides. The in-form Bilston Town (5th) host Foley Meir at home after a recent win, while Barnton, unbeaten in their last outing, host Shawbury United—who have lost their last five games and represent the division's worst current form. Crewe, struggling near the bottom, face Allscott Heath away, while Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a clash between two of the division's poorest-performing sides. Market Drayton Town visit New Mills, and Brereton Social host struggling Widnes Town, who remain pointless after seven games.
